lines.text: Currently, the Lord serves the dual purpose of providing team economy and increasing push pressure. We want to increase the push pressure of the Lord while decreasing the team economy they provide to balance the advantage gained by the team that takes them.

The Bounty system for ending kill streaks and the Team Bounty system have long helped the disadvantaged team catch up to the advantaged team, providing more opportunities for a comeback. However, due to the lack of visuals, many players still do not understand these mechanisms, making it difficult to develop tactics targeting the enemy's high bounty targets.

In this patch, we have added a display of the current bounty amount for each hero on the scoreboard (only displayed if the bounty is not less than 120 Gold), indicating the extra Gold the killer can get for eliminating that hero. We hope this will help players make better use of this mechanism to plan their tactics and ensure victory.

Additional Notes: The Killing Spree Bounty increases with the number of consecutive kills the hero makes, but is only awarded to the player who ends the spree. The Team Bounty increases by the amount the hero is ahead of the opposing team's average economy. When a leading hero is killed, the Team Bounty is distributed to all players on the killer's team.

designerNotes: In this patch, we will continue to optimize the Equipment.
Meanwhile, we will also be adjusting those heroes whose strength has been greatly increased or reduced due to Equipment adjustments.
These hero adjustments will be made in batches and will continue over several Advanced Server updates.
We will compensate heroes who have become too weak due to Equipment adjustments.
We will also be nerfing heroes that are currently strong or balanced, but have received a significant power boost due to Equipment adjustments.

As for the heroes who are currently weak, we will not adjust them until we evaluate how much the Equipment adjustments have strengthened them. We hope that the equipment adjustments can give them more opportunities to shine.

In addition, we reduced some Jungle Tanks' Jungling Speed, because they can easily clear their own Jungle and invade the enemy's Jungle. However, the Jungling Speed of some Assassin Junglers will be increased to some extent. We will continue to monitor the effects of this modification.

designerNotes: In this patch, we adjusted some default lanes for heroes to match actual lane selection in Ranked matches on the Official Server, but we also noticed some specific lane selections made by top-level players. heroes.name: Zhuxin
heroes.intro: Reduced Zhuxin's mobility and control abilities.

heroes.name: Masha
heroes.intro: We're happy to see Masha getting more usage after the previous adjustments. Now that players are getting more comfortable with her, we've found that she's too weak in the early and mid game. Masha is forced to play defensively against most other heroes on the EXP lane until level 4, and then relies on hero kills to grow enough to take down the enemy's squishy heroes in the late game. To remedy this, we want to try to increase their laning potential for a more streamlined early and mid game, while slightly nerfing their late-game burst potential.

heroes.name: Minotaur

versions.title: Patch Notes 1.8.62 (Advanced Server)
versions.summary: New control settings, Nana's Nerf, Aurora's Nerf, Fredrinn's Buff, Marksmen's Adjustments, Physical Equipment's Nerf
designerNotes: In this patch, we continue to optimize several heroes that have been adjusted significantly, as well as the new hero on the Advanced Server. At the same time, we have made some additional adjustments to some of the Marksmen heroes that were adjusted in the previous patch.

At the same time, we have removed the 10% base Attack Speed reduction for all heroes that was used in conjunction with the control optimization in the previous patch. Instead, we're balancing the adjustments with equipment.

heroes.name: Chip
heroes.intro: The mini-map will now show the Main Portal's location. After teleporting to the Main Portal, the mini-map will show the corresponding Connecting Portal's location.

changes.text: New Effect: Casting skills or launching Basic Attacks while standing on the Main Portal, will reset the wait time for teleportation.

heroes.name: Helcurt
heroes.intro: Slightly reduced the extra Movement Speed from his Passive.

changes.label: Movement Speed (decreasing over time) and Attack Speed Boost upon Being Spotted

heroes.name: Edith
heroes.intro: Reverted some of the previous adjustments.

heroes.name: Masha
heroes.intro: With so many new mechanics, Masha's Resilience and Control Immunity seemed overwhelmingly powerful, and her Mana-free skills cast on her last HP with Control Immunity all the time made it impossible for Masha's opponents to fight her. We decided to remove this passive.

changes.text: Removed Effect: Masha no longer gains extra Resilience and Control Immunity by lowering HP.

heroes.name: Nana
heroes.intro: Nana's passive currently has a nearly 100% escape rate when activated, making it impossible for many Assassins and Fighters to catch up to her. We've decided to reduce Nana's Movement Speed bonus when her Passive is active, allowing her to be caught by Assassins and Fighters in some situations.

heroes.name: Hayabusa
heroes.intro: Further enhance Hayabusa's game performance without Ultimate.

changes.text: Removed the effects of surrounding freezing.

heroes.name: Fredrinn
heroes.intro: We want Fredrinn to clear lanes a little faster in the early game.

lines.text: In this patch, we have optimized the growth of Attack Speed by removing the Attack Speed Threshold limitation, and now every 1% of Attack Speed will result in an actual Attack Speed gain. With this optimization, the growth of Attack Speed will be smoother instead of abruptly changing after reaching a certain Attack Speed. This also solves the problem of some heroes actually gaining 5.0 Attack Speed at 4.0 Attack Speed in the panel.

entries.name: Golden Staff
entries.intro: [Unique Passive - Endless Strike]

changes.label: Increase Attack Speed of Basic Attack

entries.name: Twilight Armor
entries.intro: We want to improve the versatility of Twilight Armor against burst damage.

changes.text: [Unique Passive - Twilight] (Reworked)

lines.text: Since "Move and Attack' is more beneficial at high Attack Speed, we have removed the base Attack Speed reduction adjustment for all heroes from the previous patch, but have nerfed some Attack Speed equipment.
[Controls]
Added the following Control settings:
Close Pursue: When enabled, the pursuit distance is the shortest distance outside the attack range.
Pause Movement at Joystick Center: When enabled, the hero stops moving when the Joystick stays in the center.
Filter Active Creeps: When enabled, active Creeps are attacked before inactive Creeps.
Attack Activation Distance: Provides options such as Distant, Close, and Fixed Position Based on Range.
Changed Attack Assist to Move and Pursue.
Changed Skill Smart Targeting to Accurate Indicator.
[Other]
Removed the display of the skill icons being disabled when under control for 66ms or less, allowing for more timely skill release when control is stopped.
Improved the detection of Creeps as inactive.

versions.title: Patch Notes 1.8.60 (Advanced Server)
versions.summary: Improved Move and Attack Control, Revamped Masha, Guinevere Nerf, Marksmen's Adjustments
designerNotes: In this patch, we've improved the Move and Attack control experience. It now feels smoother to Move and Attack with the same DPS. Meanwhile, many heroes who specialize in Basic Attacks have had their damage increased, requiring nerfs for balance.
In addition, we hope to increase Marksmen's Basic Attack damage in the early game, while nerfing their HP in the early game to maintain balance.

heroes.name: Masha
heroes.intro: Experimental Adjustments: The previous adjustments didn't meet our expectations, and we are still trying to make Masha the one who leads the charge and fights bravely in a crowd. While she had high damage, she couldn't get much out of defense equipment, making her very vulnerable when she was strongest on her last HP bar. In this patch, Masha will enhance herself each time she loses an HP bar and reset her Ultimate so she can spam skills. We also optimized her Energy Regen to give her better control over her HP.

changes.text: When Masha only has two HP bars left, the duration of control effects on her will be reduced by 50% and skills will only require half of their original HP Cost to cast.
When Masha only has one HP bar left, she becomes immune to control effects and doesn't need to spend HP to cast skills.
Passive: Masha gains Power of the Wild which causes her Basic Attacks to deal extra Physical Damage equal to a percentage of the enemy's Max HP.
Active: Masha spends some HP to increase her Movement and Attack Speed, enhance the next two Basic Attacks, increase the extra damage from Power of the Wild, and gain extra Energy.
Masha spends some HP to roar at enemies, dealing Physical Damage and reducing their Attack Speed.
Masha spends some HP to lunge at an enemy hero (immune to control effects during the lunge), dealing Physical Damage, slowing them, and knocking back nearby enemies.
The cooldown of this skill will be reset each time Masha loses an HP bar.
Masha gains Energy when dealing damage and can accumulate up to 100.
She gains a great amount of Energy when hitting with her Wild Power.
After leaving combat for 3s, Masha can spend 50 Energy to recover a full HP bar.

heroes.name: Chip
heroes.intro: Improved some of his gameplay experience.

changes.label: Minimum distance between Chip and Connecting Portals near allies

changes.text: This skill can only be used when not in combat.

heroes.name: Helcurt
heroes.intro: We found that Helcurt's burst damage was quite low, while his skills recharge quickly when he's out of enemy sight. This has made it too difficult for him to kill enemies in even situations, but too easy for him to quickly farm enemies once the team has gained an economic advantage. Therefore, we intend to solve this problem by increasing his burst damage and slowing the rate at which his skills recharge.

changes.text: HP Regen in Stealth: Removed 20 Base HP Regen
No longer terrifies Creeps

heroes.name: Aurora
heroes.intro: Aurora can use her Hailstone Blast at a very high frequency with Max level and CD reduction, which basically allows her to spam this skill for very little cost.

heroes.name: Hayabusa
heroes.intro: Compared to other junglers, Hayabusa seems weak in early-game combat and jungling.

heroes.name: Edith

heroes.name: Guinevere
heroes.intro: Adding Stun to Guinevere's Skill 2 has benefited Guinevere players' control experience, but as a Fighter, she is now too powerful against enemy back-row heroes.

heroes.name: Silvanna
heroes.intro: Based on the previous changes to Silvanna, we've removed the feature of her Imperial Justice locking on enemy heroes, which allows her to use her Imperial Justice without a target while also allowing enemies to dodge her Imperial Justice; we've kept the change to Cometic Lance 2 and enhanced Spiral Strangling.

changes.text: Skill Revamp: It now has only one stage where she dashes in the target direction, dealing damage to nearby enemies and stunning them. The dash distance is reduced.

heroes.name: Miya
heroes.intro: Increased Arrow of Eclipse hit rate and early game damage.

changes.text: Slightly reduced the delay time.

heroes.name: Layla
heroes.intro: Due to her Malefic Gun, Layla can only deal a lot of damage to enemies from a distance, but her lack of mobility makes it difficult for her to get away from enemies. So we'll lower the damage bonus and increase her attack instead.

lines.text: In line with the improvements to the Move and Attack control experience, we've reduced the base Attack Speed by 10% for all heroes except for Irithel, Brody, Kimmy, Wanwan, and Leomord (who do not benefit from the improvements).
Meanwhile, we've also lowered the Attack Speed of certain Attack Speed Equipment.

entries.name: Concentrated Energy
entries.intro: We hope that Magic Fighters who rely partially on Basic Attack damage will also benefit from this equipment.

entries.name: Oracle
entries.intro: We hope to make this equipment stats more universal.

changes.text: Added 25 Physical Defense and we've also changed the build path.

entries.name: Radiant Armor

Fixed an issue where the control duration of Nana's Molina Smooch was longer than expected.

entries.intro: We want Fighters with good sustainability to get more buffs! At the same time, we have optimized the Build Path for War Axe so that Fighters will receive boosts while building the War Axe. "Fighters need their own set, too!"

changes.text: Dealing damage to heroes grants 16 extra Physical Attack per second for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Gain 15% extra damage and Spell Vamp at full stacks. (This effect is reduced to 50% extra Physical Attack for Marksmen/Mages/Supports.)

Simplified Guinevere's skill descriptions.

newHeroes.title: New Hero: Cici, the Buoyant Performer

heroes.name: Kimmy
heroes.intro: We don't want Kimmy to focus too much on energy management, so we enhanced her sustained damage in the mid-to-late game and slightly lowered her damage growth.

changes.label: Basic Attack Damage
changes.before: 22% Total Physical Attack + 24% Total Magic Power, 1% increase per level
changes.after: 15% Total Physical Attack + 15% Total Magic Power at all levels

changes.label: Damage
changes.before: 20 + 22%-27% Total Physical Attack + 24%-29% Total Magic Power
changes.after: 30 + 20% Total Physical Attack + 20% Total Magic Power at all levels

changes.text: Removed Effect: Energy Regen.

heroes.name: Gusion
heroes.intro: Most of Gusion's combos rely on him recalling his daggers, and we don't want Gusion players to go through a series of complicated manoeuvres only to have the final step interrupted by factors beyond their control, making it all go to waste!

changes.text: Gusion is immune to control effects when he moves behind the marked target.

heroes.name: Yve
heroes.intro: The nerf on Yve's lane-clearing ability and on the Ice Queen's Wand were too much for Yve. We're giving back some of her slowing ability.

heroes.name: Valentina
heroes.intro: After several rounds of nerfs, Valentina's powerful Ultimate still makes her an irreplaceable choice in high-level matches and tournaments. This time around, we're increasing her Ultimate's cooldown once again in hopes of improving the usage rate of other Mages in high-rank plays.

changes.label: Cooldown
changes.after: 130% (at all levels) of the target's cooldown

heroes.name: Julian
heroes.intro: Reverted some buffs from the previous patch.

heroes.name: Nolan
heroes.intro: Slightly nerfed Nolan's combos in early and mid game.

heroes.name: Guinevere
heroes.intro: We'd like to make Guinevere's Skill 2 more "reliable" so that players can clearly see whether or not they've hit the target. We've noticed that in certain cases, the skill doesn't knock enemies airborne.

changes.text: New Effect: The first strike now briefly stuns the target hit (to better ensure that the second strike hits and knocks the target airborne).

lines.text: Reverted some of the adjustments from the last patch.
The Lord is angry! It's time to show those Tanks who's boss! As for the squishy heroes, they have a hard time already, so just leave them be this time.
Basic Attack
Fixed an issue where the True Damage text is displayed when dealing Physical Damage.
Thunder Strike

Dear Players, Over the years, we've received many requests for a hero training and testing feature. Finally, we are excited to announce that you can now playbaround with any hero more conveniently! Feel free to check out the changes in Training Camp. Below are the details of the changes:

Added the "Change Ally Hero" button. Now you don't have to leave and re-enter the battle. Just tap the button and pick the hero, skin and preparation to quickly switch between different Battle Setups, Emblems, and Battle Spells.
Added the "Change AI Enemy Hero" button. Similar to the first feature, you can also customize your Al opponent in battle.

Added the "Buy Equipment for bots" button. After summoning a dummy bot, you can tap the button to buy any equipment for them. All dummy bots share the same set of equipment (AI enemy heroes won't share the equipment set. Al heroes will buy equipment based on the selected Battle Setup and the amount the Gold they have.)
Added the "'Sell All Equipment" button. This button will be on the left of the Purchase button in the Shop. You can tap it to sell all purchased equipment.
Added the "Relocate Ally Hero" button. You can tap the button and then tap the mini-map to relocate an ally hero.

Optimized the 'Max Level" button. The first time you tap the button, the hero will be upgraded to Lv. 15, but won't learn all the skills, so you can test their skills at different levels. If you tap the button again, the hero will upgrade all the skills to the max level.
Optimized the "Reset Ally & Enemy Levels" button. Tapping the button also resets the heroes' Gold to 300.
Optimized the "Add Gold (Ally & Enemy)" button. The Gold added is raised from 2000 to 10000.
Optimized the "Close Lane" button. Tapping the button now also kills all the Minions on the battlefield.

Optimized the "Damage Dummy" button. Now the dummy bots' HP are reduced to a reasonable range, but they cannot be killed and will recover their HP after a certain amount of time without taking damage.
Added "Personal Center", where you can view your comments, likes and voting history that are recorded after the feature launches.
Removed "Comment Filter" and added the "Translate Comment" feature.
We are adding a teammate recommendation feature to the Friend List on the Advanced Server, where you can find suitable players to team up with when you don't have enough friends online.

versions.title: Patch Notes 1.8.26 (Advanced Server)
versions.summary: Roger rework, YSS and Harith buffs, Mathilda Fredrinn Mash nerfs, revamped emblem Weakness Finder, gold lane gold income nerf

heroes.name: Roger
heroes.intro: We want to emphasize Roger's tactical significance and performance, as most of the time he just dominates the game in the wolf form when the team is leading in Gold. So, we've balanced the difference in damage output between his human and the wolf forms. Roger's human form is now stronger at lowering enemies' HP while his wolf form is stronger at finishing them off.

changes.text: Revamped Passive: In human form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 5% of the target's current Hp; in wolf form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 5% of the target's lost HP.
This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against Creeps.
New Effect: Gains 40% Attack Speed for 2.5s
Optimized the control experience: Removed the backswing time after Roger lunges. He can move or attack immediately after he lunges.

heroes.name: Yi Sun-Shin
heroes.intro: We will continue to make experimental changes with Yi Sun-shin and optimize his gameplay experience.

changes.text: Gain 20% Movement Speed for 1.5s after removing the Battle Scars from a target with his skill.
Greatly increased the speed of Yi Sun-shin's longbow attacks.
New Effect: Slow enemies by 50% for 1s.

heroes.name: Harith
heroes.intro: Experimental Change: Harith's Passive does not work well against the high level CCs. So, we've changed it to enhance Harith's survivability.

changes.label: Revamped Effect
changes.before: According to the number of nearby enemy heroes, Harith gains up to 45% Resilience

changes.text: New Effect: Harith gains 15% Resilience within the range of his Ultimate.

heroes.name: Wanwan
heroes.intro: We reduced Wanwan's dash speed in the last few patches to make it easier for her opponents. However, since we increased the cooldown of her control removal ability, the dash speed nerf seemed unnecessary, so we're reverting Wanwan's dash speed change to improve her gameplay.

changes.text: Increased how much Wanwan's dash speed increases with her Attack Speed to bring it in line with the pre-nerf version.

heroes.name: Tigreal
heroes.intro: Tigreal is a Tank hero with one of the best chain control combos in the game, so we tried to make it easier for his opponents to deal with his Ultimate. But it seems we made it too easy, so we've adjusted his Ultimate - it can still be interrupted, but only by enemy heroes who are not hit by his Ultimate.

changes.text: New Effect: The first pull also stuns enemies

heroes.name: Masha
heroes.intro: Slightly nerfed the early-game buffs we gave her in the last patch; late-game buffs remain unchanged.

changes.text: Adjusted how Masha recovers HP at the fountain. Now you don't need to press any buttons to fully recover all her HP bars.

heroes.name: Selena
heroes.intro: Selena has become a solid mid lane hero with the adjustments we've made in recent patches. This time around, we've focused on increasing her lane-clearing efficiency, limiting the use of her Skill 2, and increasing her skill cap in the late game.

changes.text: New Effect: Detonating Abyssal Marks now deals double damage to Creeps.

heroes.name: Lunox
heroes.intro: Improved Lunox's survivability and increased her skill cap in the late game.

heroes.name: Julian
heroes.intro: Slightly increased the cast range.

changes.text: Slightly increased the range to match the range of his Skill 1.
Increased the cast range of the enhanced Skill 3 to the same as Skill 3.

heroes.name: Cecilion
heroes.intro: Cecilion's damage output has decreased since the revamp of Lightning Truncheon. We'll make up for that in this patch.

changes.label: Path Damage Bonus from Max Mana
End Damage Bonus from Max Mana

heroes.name: Fredrinn
heroes.intro: Fredrinn seems overly powerful and all-rounded in the high-ranked play and tournaments. So, we'll nerf his survivability.

changes.text: Conversion Ratio from Crystal Energy into HP: 25% → 20% (For damage dealt to Minions: 15% → 10%)

heroes.name: Sun
heroes.intro: Sun's burst damage has increased significantly since his Skill 2 can trigger Attack Effects. So, we're slightly nerfing his sustained damage.

heroes.name: Mathilda
heroes.intro: The nerf from the last patch didn't work as intended, so we're nerfing her Ultimate even more.

heroes.name: Rafaela
heroes.intro: Slightly reduced the range and speed of the second dash. Reverted the Movement Speed change, but reduced its duration.

changes.label: Movement Speed and Slow Immunity Duration

changes.before: Gains 1% extra Movement Speed for every 15 Magic Power
changes.after: Gains 1% extra Movement Speed for every 20 Magic Power. Also removed the Movement Speed bonus cap.

heroes.name: Terizla
heroes.intro: We want to make Terizla less dominant while keeping him as a powerful EXP Laner during the laning phase.

changes.label: Total Physical Attack Bonus for the first two hits
Total Physical Attack Bonus for the third hit

heroes.name: Balmond
heroes.intro: Experimental Change: The changes in the last patch have effectively buffed Balmond. However, the Movement Speed bonus from his Skill 2 and the hit rate of his Ultimate are too powerful, so we'll revert the changes a little bit.

heroes.name: Minsitthar
heroes.intro: We want Minsitthar to connect his Spear of Glory to following attacks more consistently. For example, use Spear of Glory + Ultimate as a great control combo; or use Spear of Glory + Shield Assault as a quick stun combo. (Enemy heroes can easily escape after being caught by Spear of Glory.)

changes.text: New Effect: Minsitthar can cast other skills while retracting the spear.

heroes.name: Aurora
heroes.intro: We've slightly adjusted her combat experience based on her recent performance.

heroes.name: Argus
heroes.intro: Improved Argus' damage and his laning ability in the early-to-mid game.

heroes.name: Aldous
heroes.intro: Slightly decreased Aldous' stack cap.

heroes.name: Angela
heroes.intro: Reduced the Ultimate's shield in the mid-to-late game.

heroes.name: Edith
heroes.intro: We nerfed Edith's survivability after she ejects from Phylax.

changes.label: Skill 1&2 Cooldown Reduction for every Basic Attack

entries.name: Weakness Finder-Talent
entries.intro: Revamped. Basic Attacks slow enemies' Movement Speed by 90% and Attack Speed by 50% for 0.5s. Cooldown: 10s. Each Basic Attack reduces the cooldown by 1s.

lines.text: We'll make some balance changes to the Emblems based on their performance so far. We've also noticed that Weakness Finder doesn't seem to be a good choice for many heroes, and we intend to make it a viable option for heroes who count every Basic Attack for damage.

The survivability of Gold Laners has improved significantly because Supports can protect them more effectively, so we've made some changes to the Gold Lane to keep the balance between the different positions.

entries.name: Jungling Equipment
entries.intro: Junglers with multiple defensive equipment are just too powerful in this patch. So we intend to slow down their jungling speed in the mid-to-late game. Unique Passive: Hunter

entries.name: Berserker's Fury
entries.intro: Slightly delayed the dominant phase of heroes that focus on Crit.

changes.label: Movement Speed Boost
changes.after: 30% Movement Speed Boost that decays in 2s

lines.text: Roger now gains shield from his Ultimate at the beginning of the dash instead of during the dash.
Uranus now gains shield from his Skill 2 at the beginning of the dash instead of during the dash.
Vale's skill effects have been reverted to the previous version for now, and will be reintroduced in future patches.
Added the "Featured" page to help you easily find the featured content.
Added "DEV Talk". There will be more opportunities to talk to the developers.

versions.title: Patch Notes 1.8.24 (Advanced Server)
versions.summary: Aurora revamp, Argus YSS and Balmond experiments, and Selena Moskov nerf

heroes.name: Argus
heroes.intro: Experimental Adjustments: Argus's current gameplay is a bit too bland. His Ultimate seems to be both offensive and defensive, but in fact, it's difficult to achieve the desired effect. The Curse Damage of Meteoric Sword constitutes a lot of his strength, but it doesn't match his style of spamming Basic Attack. So we decided to redesign Argus's skill set and combat experience.

changes.text: New Effect: Extra Attack ignores 50% of the target's Physical Defense.
The Skill Recharge logic of the Malice Energy has been adjusted from recharging based on the damage dealt, to recharging every second and on every Basic Attack (critical hit grants extra recharge).
Slightly reduced the dash distance when used again
Increased the dash speed when used again
New Effect: The Meteoric Sword damage now counts as Basic Attack damage and can trigger Attack Effect.
New Effect: The Meteoric Sword's attack interval now shortens as the Attack Speed increases.
New Effect: Argus' Basic Attack against a cursed target will grant double Malice Energy charging speed.
Removed Effect: Curse no longer deals damage.
New Effect: Argus passively increases the charging speed of the Malice Energy.
Removed Effect: Argus permanently gains 10-30 Physical Attack.

heroes.name: Yi Sun-shin
heroes.intro: Experimental adjustment: We reworked Yi Sun-shin's Passive to make his Basic Attack purpose clearer. The arrow damage of his Skill 2 has also been greatly increased to create the experience that Yi Sun-shin can destroy the enemy with a single attack after hitting them with a fully charged shot.

changes.text: Revamped Effect: The longbow's Basic Attack will add Battle Scars to the target, up to 4 stacks. The glaive's Basic Attack can consume all the Battle Scars on the target and increase the damage of that Basic Attack.
Revamped CD Reduction: Each Battle Scars stack consumed reduces this skill's cooldown by 1s.
Removed the slash for Skill 2
This skill can add Battle Scars to the target, and the number of stacks added will increase with the charging time.
This skill can add Battle Scars to the target.

heroes.name: Chang'e
heroes.intro: We want Chang'e to be able to deal good damage without high Passive stacks, and enhance her ability to slow the enemies at the same time.

changes.text: Removed the damage increase effect, slows down the target by 1% for each stack, up to 20%.

heroes.name: Balmond
heroes.intro: Experiment adjustment: Optimized control experience. We want Balmond's combos to be smoother. This adjustment also optimizes the problem that Balmond often misses his Ultimate at close range.

changes.text: New Effect: Cyclone sweep will not be interrupted by control abilities (it could be interrupted by airborne effect)
New Effect: Gain 20% Movement Speed bonus during skill cast.

changes.label: Base Damage
changes.after: 25-100 + 25% Total Physical Attack, double the hit rate (Total Damage remains unchanged).

changes.text: Increased skill range and optimized visual effects
New Effect: The skill cannot be interrupted by control effects.

heroes.name: Moskov
heroes.intro: Since the teleport from Moskov's Ultimate gives him an extremely powerful micro potential, we nerfed his Ultimate damage to balance things out. We also optimized his Basic Attack control while nerfing the power of some other parts.

changes.text: Slightly shortened his Basic Attack's foreswing time to make it smoother.
Reduced Penetrate Damage to 1.1 times Base Damage.

heroes.name: Vale
heroes.intro: Optimization: Vale's skill effects have been fully upgraded! The overall effects are more in line with the current gameplay.

changes.text: New Effect: While the Windstorm lasts, it will continue to deal small amounts of damage to enemies within the range.

heroes.name: Aldous
heroes.intro: After the last adjustment, we found that Aldous' stack building speed has been significantly improved. But we also noticed that players wanted him to be more powerful in the late game. So we decided to make some changes.

heroes.name: Masha
heroes.intro: We found that Masha's Skill 1 is too strong, causing her to be extremely powerful in the mid-game than in the late-game. This adjustment transfers some of the Attack Speed attributes from skills to normal growth, and slightly reduces the cooldown of Skill 1 in the early game.

heroes.name: Khaleed
heroes.intro: Last week's changes made the damage increase to Khaleed's Skill 1 no longer necessary. So we decided to remove this effect and slightly enhance his ability to clear lanes in the mid-to-late game.

changes.label: Removed Effect
changes.before: 15% damage increase per hit Damage on Minions: 50%

heroes.name: Selena
heroes.intro: Slightly reduced her strength after we made her easier to play, and optimized her skill descriptions

changes.text: Basic Attacks under Abyssal form will no longer detonate the Abyssal Mark.

heroes.name: Dyrroth
heroes.intro: Dyrroth has been balanced after several adjustments. This time we decided to buff his damage but nerf his cooldown, so that Dyrroth has a better experience when casting skills while maintaining his overall strength.

changes.text: Slightly increased the skill cooldown.
Slightly increased Damage and CD

heroes.name: Ixia
heroes.intro: Decreased Ixia's mid-late game damage potential.

changes.text: Removed the "Siphon Starlium" damage growth from the hero's level upgrade.

heroes.name: Ixia
heroes.intro: Decreased Ixia's mid-late game damage potential.

changes.text: Removed the "Siphon Starlium" damage growth from the hero's level upgrade.

heroes.name: Rafaela
heroes.intro: After Rafaela has the slow immunity, her own Movement Speed bonus effect is a bit too high. We decided to decrease the base Movement Speed bonus and increase the Magic Power bonus slightly.

changes.before: Gains 1% extra Movement Speed for every 20 Magic Power
changes.after: Gains 1% extra Movement Speed for every 15 Magic Power

heroes.name: Joy
heroes.intro: The optimized Joy with cooldown reduction equipment made her cooldown a bit too short in the late game.

heroes.name: Mathilda
heroes.intro: We're happy to see Mathilda back in action, but buffing her seems a bit too much and we're nerfing her strength slightly.

changes.label: Duration of Ally's Movement Speed Boost

heroes.name: Floryn
heroes.intro: Slightly increased Flower of Hope's damage.

entries.name: Twilight Armor
entries.intro: We want it to be able to block high damage more accurately, rather than being easily triggered in the later game. We also want it to be more resistant to high damage after being triggered.

changes.text: Triggering Condition: Taking more than 600 damage with a single hit → Taking more than 800 damage with a single hit Threshold for Triggering Effect: 150 → 300

entries.name: Lightning Truncheon
entries.intro: We want to give some Mages good mobility by enhancing this equipment, and remove the strong binding between this equipment and the Clock of Destiny.

changes.text: New Effect: When triggering the damage, increase Movement Speed by 20% for 2s.

lines.text: Optimized the experience of auto pursuit after kills.
Optimized Lunox's default Battle Setup and skill descriptions
Fixed the bug where sometimes the target could not be switched in hero lock-on mode

versions.title: Patch Notes 1.8.22 (Advanced Server)
versions.summary: Joy rework, Lunox adjustments, and Selena Moskov Khaleed buff

heroes.name: Joy
heroes.intro: Experimental adjustments: We wanted to make it easier for Joy's opponents to deal with her, while at the same time making her less difficult to play. Joy's enemy can now interrupt her Skill 2 with CCs. Joy should now look for the right time to enter the fight. But she still has options if her Skill 2 is interrupted.

changes.text: Removed Effect: Immune to control effects during Beat Time!.
Her Ultimate now unlocks after she casts her Skill 2 on beat once, but her Ultimate damage still scales with the number of Skill 2 casts on beat.
Her Ultimate with 4 Skill 2 casts on beat makes her immune to control effects during the Ultimate.

changes.before: Multiple skill hits on the same target will deal 20% less damage each time, down to 20%
changes.after: 15% less damage each time, down to 55%.

heroes.name: Lunox
heroes.intro: We've decided not to add or remove Lunox's skills, but we'll keep the adjustments to her power stacks and other parts. Also, we'll keep an eye on the adjustments to her Passive that converts her attribute. The following are the adjustments made based on the skills available on the Official Server.

changes.text: Changed the stack cap from 2 Order or Chaos to 1 each.
New Effect: Lunox's skills can now benefit from the Cooldown Reduction bonuses.
Revamped Effect: Based on Lunox's form, her Spell Vamp and Percentage Magic Penetration are now converted to one another at the ratio of 1:1.25.
No longer slows enemies by 10%.
Her Skill 2 no longer costs mana during her Ultimate in Chaos form.
Added the visual effects of her damage area after she casts the Ultimate.

heroes.name: Selena
heroes.intro: We've decided to stop adjusting Selena's marks and only keep some of the basic experience optimizations for the following tests. The following are the adjustments made based on the skills available on the Official Server.

changes.text: New Effect: Marks can now be applied to Minions.
Damage adjustments to non-hero targets are the same as to heroes.
Slightly increased the explosion range.
Fixed an issue where the actual slow effect of the first strike did not match its description.
New Effect: Hitting a marked enemy now refreshes the cooldown of her Skill 2 (Abyssal).
Removed the mana cost.
Removed the mana cost.

heroes.name: Moskov
heroes.intro: The new effect of Moskov's Ultimate has given him new possibilities, so we're nerfing the other effects of his Ultimate hit and hoping that the new effect is used more often. We also want Moskov to be able to teleport directly to a location with his Ultimate instead of having to move again with Skill 1 to get the Attack Speed boost. So we'll give his Ultimate an Attack Speed bonus, but slightly nerf his Attack Speed bonuses while he's not using his Ultimate.

changes.text: New Effect: The second strike of his Ultimate now boosts Attack Speed like his Skill 1.

heroes.name: Masha
heroes.intro: We're going with the previous adjustments to Masha and fine-tuning her gameplay in following patches. Masha's skills are now adjusted to the Patch 1.8.18 Advanced Server version.

heroes.name: Alucard
heroes.intro: Based on player feedback, we're optimizing the changes to Alucard and keeping the skill-centric play style. The following are the adjustments made based on the skills available on the Official Server.

changes.text: Removed Effect: Deals more damage when hitting only one hero.
New Effect: His Ultimate absorbs Hybrid Defense from nearby enemy heroes.
Removed Effect: His Ultimate grants extra Hybrid Lifesteal.
Removed Effect: Deals extra damage with his Passive to targets hit.

heroes.name: Nana
heroes.intro: The experimental adjustments returned. We're optimizing the logic of her Skill 2 so that players can still use it to reveal an area and as a roadblock.

changes.text: Visual Optimizations: Updated the on-hit and explosion effects; added a range indicator.
Logic Optimizations: Enemies that are transformed after a direct hit will now flee in the direction of the skill, not away from Nana.
New Effect: If the skill doesn't transform an enemy hero, Molina remains on the target location for 2s.

heroes.name: Dyrroth
heroes.intro: We're going with the previous adjustments to Dyrroth and fine-tuning his gameplay in following patches.

changes.text: Slightly reduced the base damage of Skill 1.

heroes.name: Odette
heroes.intro: Optimized the skill cooldown to slightly increase her damage.

heroes.name: Sun
heroes.intro: We're upgrading Sun's graphics quality and increasing his burst damage. Since his skins aren't upgraded accordingly yet, we're removing them temporarily

changes.text: New Effect: The skill damage counts as Basic Attack damage and can trigger the Attack Effect.

heroes.name: Khaleed
heroes.intro: We're making Khaleed's skills easier to use.

changes.text: The skill will now cast 3 times with or without hitting a target.
Slightly increased the dash speed.
Slightly increased channeling speed.

heroes.name: Arlott
heroes.intro: Arlott's opponents now have enough time to react to his Ultimate after we increased the skill's foreswing time. So we are reverting the rest of the previous nerfs.

lines.text: Slightly increased the time it takes for an enemy to disappear after entering the bush.
Increased heroes' turn speed.
Golden Staff can now properly trigger Yu Zhong's Passive stacks.
Fixed an issue where Dyrroth's Ultimate would be interrupted when knocked airborne.
